t: Growth curve fitting — Storage Capacity Forecaster (Signature)
title: Growth curve fitting — Storage Capacity Forecaster (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The storage capacity forecaster turns measured growth into procurement and pruning decisions: it models each collection's growth curve, projects when capacity runs out, and recommends actions — add storage, compress, tier, or retire — before the crunch. Surprises about disk space are operational failures; forecasting makes them planning inputs. The models stay humble, reporting confidence intervals rather than false precision.

This record documents the growth curve fitting approach: Fit linear, exponential, and logistic models to historical usage and pick by backtested error.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Storage Capacity Forecaster demo: least-squares trend + exhaustion date.
months=[120,131,140,152,163,175]  # GB used, last 6 months
n=len(months); sx=sum(range(n)); sy=sum(months)
sxx=sum(i*i for i in range(n)); sxy=sum(i*m for i,m in enumerate(months))
slope=(n*sxy-sx*sy)/(n*sxx-sx*sx); intercept=(sy-slope*sx)/n
cap=300
need=(cap-intercept)/slope
print("growth %.1f GB/month -> capacity in month %.1f (~%.0f months left)"%(slope,need,need-(n-1)))
lo,hi=slope*0.8,slope*1.2
print("80%% band: %.1f-%.1f months left"%((cap-intercept)/hi-(n-1),(cap-intercept)/lo-(n-1)))
provenance: Signature-generated-completion: original Signature-authored content by the JAH system, clearly labeled, not a public record.
